corrected_claims.text: Supported date formats for standard collections in Atlas Online Archive include ISODATE, EPOCH_SECONDS, EPOCH_MILLIS, EPOCH_NANOSECONDS, and OBJECT_ID.
ISODATE is the default date format for Atlas Online Archive criteria.
Epoch-based date formats (EPOCH_SECONDS, EPOCH_MILLIS, EPOCH_NANOSECONDS) require the specified date field to be of BSON type long.
Time series collections must use ISODATE as the date format for archival rules.
The `dataExpirationRule.expireAfterDays` parameter, which specifies the number of days used for nominating documents for deletion from the archive, must be an integer between 7 and 9215 days.
Using the OBJECT_ID format enables archival based on the timestamp embedded within the MongoDB ObjectId.
